narrative.intro: Johns Hopkins Medical Services has $495M in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Johns Hopkins Medical Services recorded one award this fiscal year with an average award size of $495M, and obligations are up 2.0% year over year. Annual obligations have risen steadily from $448M in FY21, to $456M in FY22, to $474M in FY23, to $490M in FY24, to $485M in FY25, and to $495M in FY26. The current-year total is partial and reflects fiscal year to date obligations. This record shows a multi-year upward trend in absolute obligations with modest year-over-year growth reported for the current fiscal snapshot. Contractors and program managers watching Johns Hopkins Medical Services should note the concentration implied by a single large award in the current year and the steady incremental increases in annual obligations over the past six fiscal years.
